title: Koinon agent template
description: A building block for an agent draft (ADR 0020): harness choices, instructions, model, suggested grants and limits. Creating an agent from a template always yields a draft; an org admin or owner activates it and approves its grants.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of this document. Stays v1alpha1 until 1.0 (ADR 0027).

id.description: Stable identifier; also the file name (<id>.yaml). Never reused for a different template.

version.description: SemVer of the template content. Bump it whenever the content hash changes.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the template picker.

harness.description: The harnesses the agent may run on (ADR 0112) and the harness settings. The default must be one of the allowed harnesses.

pluginInstalls.description: Let the agent install OpenCode plugins: the sandbox may read the npm registry (registry.npmjs.org, GET and HEAD only, no credentials) from the OpenCode binary, and OpenCode loads the plugins in the agent's home and its config. Off by default. Applies to the OpenCode harness only, so opencode must be an allowed harness.

model.description: Model reference. The name is logical and is resolved against the install's model list when the agent is created; "default" means the install's default model.

thinking.description: The starting value of the agent's thinking setting. Thinking is on unless an agent turns it off; a model that cannot think ignores the setting.

ephemeral.description: Agents made from this template are ephemeral: each task runs in a fresh sandbox with no persistent home, deleted when the task ends. Memory lives in task notes and the memory stores. Off by default (persistent).

questions.description: When the questions this agent asks with ask_user get their reminder and when they expire and apply their safe default (ADR 0065 decision 10). Durations from the moment of asking, as whole hours, minutes or seconds. Omitted values take the defaults: reminderAfter 24h, expireAfter 168h (7 days).

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits of the agent's sandbox (ADR 0083), Kubernetes quantities such as 250m or 1Gi. Every value is optional; an unset one takes the platform default, and the platform bounds clamp all of them. A request must not exceed its limit.

instructions.description: Markdown instructions for the agent, written to the harness's instruction file.

tools.description: Tools the instructions expect the agent to call, by tool name as the MCP guard classifies them (ADR 0091). Optional. Name every tool the instructions use, also one they describe only in prose; the template legs check (ADR 0084 decision 9) reads this list. MCP servers are not named: an admin allows them on the agent.

grants.description: Suggested grants. The template proposes; an admin or owner approves on activation (ADR 0020). Each scope must exist on the connector type, which is checked when the template is synced.

triggers.description: What starts work on the agent (ADR 0066): a schedule or a direct message in the inbox chat. Each has a filter typed by its type (no expression language) and an instruction given to the agent when it fires. They are part of the agent version and take effect when a version holding them is activated. code_host_event and channel_event are reserved for v0.2.

run.description: Per-run limits (ADR 0049, ADR 0081). The first one reached cancels the run with a ticket event; the agent is told at about 80% of the nearest.

maxDuration.description: Wall-clock cap as a Go duration in whole hours, minutes or seconds, for example 30m. At most 24h.

maxModelRequests.description: Model requests per run (ADR 0081). Optional: without it a run gets the platform default of 200. Every request through the agent's key counts, the harness's own title, summary and compaction calls included, so it is the same on every model and binds on models priced at zero.

maxSpendUSD.description: USD a single run may spend, by the ledger's settled cost (ADR 0081). Optional: without it a run gets the platform default of $5.00. A decimal string with at most two fraction digits. The gateway enforces it between ledger passes as the run level of the agent's key limit.

maxTokens.description: Deprecated and ignored: tokens are reported, not enforced (ADR 0081). Still accepted, so a template that sets only it validates; the platform defaults then apply to its runs.

spendUSD.description: Per-agent spend limit in USD per calendar day in UTC, pushed to agentgateway (plan item L1, ADR 0050). A decimal string with at most two fraction digits, so it never goes through a float.

id.description: Names the trigger within the agent; stable across versions.

filter.description: Typed by the trigger type. schedule: cron (five fields) and an IANA timezone. direct_message: none.

instruction.description: Text given to the agent when the trigger fires.

notify.description: Who is asked when the agent asks a person without naming one. Left out: the org's default (its admins; from v0.2 its notify channel when one is set). A template names a role; a person is picked on the agent's Edit triggers page.

connector.description: Connector type ID (ADR 0007), for example github.

preset.description: Approval preset mapping risk tiers to allow, ask or deny (ADR 0008, 0049).

targets.description: How many targets of the connection (for GitHub: repositories) the user picks when creating the agent. Omitted means the connector type decides.

purpose.description: Why the agent needs this grant, shown to the admin who activates it.
